input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research/buildbot-sheathing milestone 60: a raised leg preload for the presses milestone 59's flip bound leaves unplanned

errors.what: First probe attempt used the system python3, which lacks numpy; pyenv.py found /usr/bin/python3.13 with numpy, scipy and mujoco.
A foreground 2-case probe timed out at 115 s because importing the milestone chain (m38 to m59) alone takes about a minute; reran in the background.

doc_friction.issue: Each milestone's run.py imports the previous one's, 22 levels deep (m60 -> m59 -> m58 -> m56 -> ... -> m38); importing takes about a minute and any small probe pays it, so a 120 s foreground check rarely fits. A shared module for the current rule would make probes cheap.

notes: Hypotheses H235-H237 registered and pushed (commit before the run) from a development probe on seed 59's 19 unplanned cases. Held-out seed 60 (48 loads x 6 errors, 9408 in-envelope cases, 1229 s on 4 processes): uniform leg preload raise to 0.12-0.18 N m plans 17 of the H1's 18 unplanned cases (all left knee) inside 0.03 mm at nose and depth point with no flip (H237 held); H1 coverage 99.67% -> 99.98%; median leg effort +0.1%, max +13.5%. H235 refuted (an H1 elbow case and 3 G1 cases with no plan on any side stay unplanned); H236 refuted (targeted knee-only raise plans the same 17). Checks run locally: project pytest 222 passed 4 skipped; paper/check_numbers.py 419 of 419; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; check_posts ok; programme_check ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer adapting the m59 rule, writing the escalation, running and writing up a held-out experiment

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
